name: HSC Mathematics Advanced
description: HSC Mathematics Advanced — past-paper question bank

_comments.assetBaseUrl: Public origin of the papers R2 bucket (papers.hsc.pebnum.com = hsc-papers-and-resources). CANONICAL crop URL = <assetBaseUrl>/<subject>/papers/<paperSlug>/<assetKey>, where paperSlug = paperId with the '<subject>-' prefix stripped (matches bucket folders) and assetKey = q<N>.pdf for a question / a<N>.pdf for its answer, N NOT zero-padded (q1.pdf, q11.pdf). Audio stays on audioBaseUrl.
_comments.papers: Baked question+answer PDFs live in content/<id>/papers/ locally (gitignored) and in R2 under the <id>/ prefix; metadata is the questions manifest. Papers-first subject: no episodes yet, so groupNames/yearMap are empty.
